name: Bacorbladra
text: Bacorbladra is a teacher of the Partholonian people in the Lebor Gabala. The old text names him as the first foster father of Ireland. His office is to raise a child of the settlers and to hold the place of a father to him. The name is also written with a second form in the book.

attributes.attribute: a teacher of the Parthon people

okr.objective: Record the first foster father of Ireland.
key_results: Give the office of foster father.
Note the two forms of the name.
